product_overview: Shesheny Motors is a luxury car dealership website where guests can browse inventory, view vehicle details, manage deposit-related actions, and submit custom car requests. The platform also includes an authenticated admin area for managing inventory and related content.
core_goals: Browse the car inventory and inspect vehicle details
Filter and search cars to find relevant listings
Place a deposit item into the cart and submit a deposit request
Submit a custom car request with budget and requirements
Log in to the admin dashboard to manage dealership content

features.name: Browse Inventory
features.description: Allows guests to view the car listing and narrow results by search or filters.
user_flows: Navigate to /inventory.html -> Browse the list of cars -> Filter cars -> See the inventory update with matching vehicles
Navigate to /inventory.html -> Browse the list of cars -> Select a car to view more details -> See the car details page open

features.name: View Car Details
features.description: Shows detailed information for a selected car, including visuals and key specifications.
user_flows: Navigate to /details.html -> View the car's price, specs, and description -> Browse the image gallery -> See the selected image update in the main view
Navigate to /details.html -> Add the car to favorites -> Return later and see the liked car preserved
Navigate to /details.html -> Add the car for deposit -> See the car added to the cart

features.name: Deposit Cart and Request Submission
features.description: Lets customers review deposit selections and submit a deposit request from the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart.html -> Review the cars added for deposit -> Fill in the deposit request form -> Submit the request -> See the cart submission complete

features.name: Custom Car Request
features.description: Allows guests to submit a specialized vehicle request based on budget and requirements.
user_flows: Navigate to /request.html -> Fill in the budget and requirements details -> Submit the custom request -> See the request submission complete

features.name: Admin Login and Dashboard Access
features.description: Provides authenticated access to the administrative dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login.html -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the admin dashboard
